topic: Data missing for early November session data
summary_markdown: A user questioned the inclusion of a forecast in the `device_session` dataset, noting that real data for the first week of November (specifically 2024-10-30 through 2024-11-11) appeared to be missing or overwritten by the forecast. A second issue raised was that an attempt to recalculate using `model2` failed to incorporate the added forecast data.
action_items: The user needs confirmation that the historical session data for early November has been restored and is available for use in model calculations.
